reason_call_cap_unfixed: Select one minimal qualification branch AFTER reviewing C1;no open-ended execution budget or approved experiment is implied.
C1_trigger: user decides whether same-target conditional shot/total tradeoff merits qualification;not automatic

priorities.route: audit finite native gate alphabet/head/relative Gaussian/central signed events and symbolic Qiskit P0 identities;reuse existing telescoping and shell propagation
priorities.useful_bound: uniform local/operator bounds and numerical reference defects across ALL events and compiler paths,then r*s*2^m propagation
priorities.requires_new_molecular_numerics: likely for rotation/reference enclosures or local residual tables;separate fixed SOURCE/calls before evaluation
priorities.blocker: whole-kernel P0 optimizer combines gates across event boundaries;sample or individual-event compiled residual is insufficient for uniform final-kernel bound
priorities.no_claim: no automatic promotion of B2 maxima or single-particle Gaussian diagnostic to full-law certificate

priorities.route: compare exact declared atom weights,represented probabilities,normalization and pinned numpy.choice mapping;explicit random-bit/IID model
priorities.scale: two finite atom/probability tables and boundary/error arithmetic;no trajectory enumeration or new calibration samples
priorities.propagation: if per-event TV<=eta under stated IID model,raw ideal-unitary mean signal difference<=2*r*s*2^m*eta,capped by2;include probability-rounding and random-grid mapping;compiled gate error separate
priorities.caveat: PCG64 deterministic pseudorandom substreams do not themselves prove ideal IID law or a total variation guarantee over quantum shots

priorities.item: cost support and simultaneous mean uncertainty
priorities.blocks: guaranteed population cost comparison,not C1 point proxy
priorities.route: structural all-word P0 output gate-count/depth bound with provenance;reuse bounded_cost_intervals on the SAME32 samples with alpha_cost/12
priorities.scale: static pass-count/translation and finite-IR audit first;no automatic new64-cohort or exponential-word compile
priorities.need_new_samples: only if valid support intervals exist and are decision-inconclusive;user chooses a new fixed cohort separately
priorities.unsupported: sample max/min,mean SE or per-event price sums are not full-kernel support bounds
priorities.ideal_mean_transfer: cost range plus law TV could bound transfer once both qualified;otherwise ideal mean stays null

priorities.item: rigorous PF/DF/reference rounding and final CA
priorities.route: retain existing binary64 pilot label;obtain independent enclosures only if main claim needs them;no automatic recomputation
defer until fixed H4 same-accuracy tradeoff and baseline are assessed;no new fits or scope expansion

preservation: no new scientific runs under this design draft
